confidence_notes: Recent Valparaiso cost-of-living data supports the meal, cappuccino, beer and cocktail estimates, though contributor coverage is limited. comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city used; food and drink estimates are grounded in Valparaiso-specific cost-of-living data, with the city's coastal tourism considered for the holistic accommodation estimates.
